name: Skybridge
description: Full-stack open source React framework for building MCP Apps that handles infrastructure and dev loop so developers can focus on features. Write once, run in Claude, ChatGPT, VSCode, and any MCP client. Ranked #2 Product of the Week on Product Hunt.

name: jebi
description: A supercharged terminal for Mac with built-in local AI that provides intelligent suggestions after each command. No API key, subscription, or cloud required. Ranked on Product Hunt weekly leaderboard with 114 upvotes.

name: AgentX
description: Multi-agent and evaluation framework that evaluates AI agents before they fail. Allows building and evaluating multi-AI agents with any LLM, pinpoint issues, and fix with one click. Ranked #1 Product of the Day on June 22, 2026.

name: Sipcode
description: Context hygiene tool for Claude Code that caps verbose tool output and dedupes same-session file re-reads to reduce context bloat and improve answer quality. MIT licensed with measured 29% quality lift and 40% reduction in agent errors.
community_quotes: Context bloat is my #1 frustration with Claude Code in long sessions
The 40% agent error reduction stat is the one that got my attention
The re-read dedup looks like a clear win
The dogfooding story sells this more than any benchmark — discovering your own drift tool read 624,940 tokens wasted

name: Conduit
description: Local MCP gateway that fixes tool-list bloat in AI agents by routing tools through one local gateway with 3 meta-tools for on-demand searching. Measured 97% reduction in token overhead and 90% reduction in overall token usage.

name: HumanLayer
description: Agentic IDE that serves as a human-in-the-loop answer to lights-out coding-agent slop. Enables engineers to solve hard problems in complex codebases with AI coding agents while maintaining code quality.

name: HiveMind
description: Weights & Biases launched HiveMind, a dashboard for tracking AI coding-agent sessions, spend, transcripts, ROI, and reusable organizational learning. Provides observability for coding agent fleets.

name: Devin Desktop
description: Cognition rebranded Windsurf into Devin Desktop, a multi-agent command center with Agent Client Protocol (ACP) support. Consolidates IDE acquisition into Devin agent brand as a desktop control surface for running multiple coding agents.

name: Hermes Desktop
description: Nous Research launched Hermes Desktop, packaging the Hermes Agent harness into a native desktop app for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Features chat, permissions, tool-call visibility, reasoning traces, and admin controls.
